ja: 新シリーズ「BB戦士三国伝 風雲豪傑編」より無双の貴公子“張飛ガンダム”が登場 背中の翼と槍が、長大な蛇矛に合体 鎧の着脱により軽装形態を再現 握り拳以外に、表情の付いた平手（左手）が付属
en: Introducing the unparalleled nobleman "Zhang Fei Gundam" from the new series "BB Senshi Sangokuden Wind and Cloud Goketsu Edition" The wings and spear on his back combine into a long snake spear Reproduce the light armored form by attaching and detaching the armor In addition to the clenched fist, a flat hand (left hand) with an expression is included
